resumen: Reserva: lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:00, Dr. Andrés Sáez, Arenal Norte

eventos.texto: Good morning, Clínica Arenal, you're through to reception. How can I help you today?
Hello, I've had headaches most afternoons for about a month. I'd like to see someone.
Por lo que cuenta (dolores de cabeza), lo encamina a medicina general
Falta un segundo dato para confirmar quién es
Thanks. And to be sure I have the right record, could I have the DNI, or the date of birth?
Ficha encontrada: Mario G. (por DNI y nombre)
Ofrece el lunes 21 de septiembre a las 8:00 con el Dr. Andrés Sáez en Arenal Norte
Thank you, Mario, I have your record here. The earliest I have is Monday the 21st of September at 8 am with Dr. Andrés Sáez at Arenal Norte. Shall I book that for you?
Reserva · lunes 21 de septiembre, 8:00 · Dr. Andrés Sáez · Arenal Norte
That's booked: Monday the 21st of September at 8 am with Dr. Andrés Sáez at Arenal Norte. Is there anything else I can help with?
Thank you for calling. Take care, goodbye.
